standard_prerequisites.name: Signed tableau rules for the conditional
standard_prerequisites.statement: From True (A implies B) the True-implies rule derives False A and True B on the branch; from False (A implies B) the False-implies rule branches into True A and False B.
standard_prerequisites.use: Item (1) closes via the True-implies derivations against True A and False B; item (2) closes via the False-implies branches together with the True-not rule in the first tree.

standard_prerequisites.name: Signed tableau rules for negation
standard_prerequisites.statement: From True (not A) the True-not rule derives False A.
standard_prerequisites.use: The first tree of item (2) closes its True A branch by applying the True-not rule to the assumed True (not A).

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1158-1165): (1) A, A implies B proves B; (2) both not A proves A implies B and B proves A implies B.

Item (1) (proof lines 1169-1181): a closed tableau for {False B, True (A implies B), True A}: the True-implies rule derives False A and True B; the False A branch closes against True A and the True B branch closes against False B.

Item (2) (proof lines 1182-1207): closed tableaux for {False (A implies B), True (not A)} and for {False (A implies B), True B}: the False-implies rule branches into True A and False B; in the first tree the True A branch is closed by deriving False A via the True-not rule against the True (not A) assumption, in the second tree the False B branch closes against True B.
proof_roadmap: Witness item (1) with the True-implies derivations closing both branches.
Witness the not-A half of item (2) using the False-implies split plus the True-not rule.
Witness the B half of item (2) with the False-implies split closing against True B.
difficulty_reason: Conditional provability facts (statement 1158-1165, proof 1169-1207): all three closed-tableau constructions carried in span, including the True-not closure in item (2). H2.
